title: Mill AI Full-Awareness — Dispatcher, Resource Wiring, Tribal Knowledge, Machine Profiles
description: Close the mill-vs-lathe awareness asymmetry. Mill has 109 domain engines but only 6 aiReasoningDispatcher actions (5% wired) vs lathe's 82 turning actions on 57 engines (44% wired). JM DIE mill roots contain 566 mill files across CNC MILL HAAS (58 customers/41 files), HAAS-HURCO (63 customers/41 files), ROKU-ROKU (78 customers/34 files), and MATTHEW programs (444 files). Resources folder includes hyperMILL 31.0/33.0, WinMax Mill docs, Mastercam X8 Haas posts, HSMWorks 2026 posts for Haas/Hurco/Okuma, and 14+ machine simulation models. This milestone creates a dedicated MillingDispatcher, wires all unwired mill engines, generates test coverage, adds machine profile catalogs (Haas VF-2, Hurco VMX 30i, Roku-Roku HC-658, Okuma Genos M460V-5AX), bridges MillAISelfAwarenessIntegrationEngine to the central PRISMSelfAwarenessEngine, indexes mill tribal knowledge for search, and expands MachiningPlaybookEngine with mill-specific rules. Coordinates with a parallel PRISM-wide awareness roadmap being built in another chat — this track focuses specifically on MILL scope.
